source_scope: Key Terms, Other Changes to Standard Terms, Teaching Adaptation 1 — this is identified as a replacement to Section 12.6 Standard Terms and controls over the original wording for CONTRACT-01 v2. Full contract position requires signed cover pages and any amendments, which have not been supplied.
established_facts: Equator is the Provider; Victoria is the Customer.
Equator has communicated a proposed internal reorganisation.
The applicable provision is Teaching Adaptation 1, which modifies Section 12.6.
unresolved_facts: Whether the proposed internal reorganisation constitutes a 'change of control' of Equator.
Whether the reorganisation is 'within a wholly owned group'.
Whether Equator will remain responsible for its obligations under the Agreement.
Equator's ownership chart has not been received.
No written confirmation that Equator remains responsible.
No statement on whether the Agreement will be transferred (which would be an assignment, a separate trigger).

quotations.location: Key Terms, Other Changes to Standard Terms, Teaching Adaptation 1, sentence 2
quotations.quote: In addition, Provider must obtain Customer's prior written consent before a change of control of Provider takes effect.

quotations.location: Key Terms, Other Changes to Standard Terms, Teaching Adaptation 1, sentence 3
quotations.quote: That consent is not required for a reorganization within a wholly owned group if Provider remains responsible for its obligations under this Agreement.

analysis: The consent requirement in sentence 2 is triggered only by a 'change of control of Provider.' An internal reorganisation does not automatically constitute a change of control. A change of control typically involves a shift in ultimate ownership or voting power. Even if a change of control occurs, the exception in sentence 3 removes the consent requirement if two conditions are met: (1) the reorganisation is within a wholly owned group, and (2) Provider remains responsible for its obligations. The exception's conditions being unmet does not itself establish that a change of control has occurred — the triggering event must be established first. Assignment (sentence 1) is a separate transaction from a share-level change of control; no transfer of the Agreement has been stated.
conclusion: Whether consent applies cannot be determined on current facts. Victoria must first establish whether a change of control of Equator is occurring. If so, consent is required unless Equator demonstrates both conditions of the exception. Victoria should request: (1) confirmation whether the reorganisation involves a change of control; (2) Equator's ownership chart showing whether it is within a wholly owned group; (3) written confirmation Equator remains responsible for its obligations; (4) clarification whether the Agreement will be transferred.
